lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple columns of high-intensity circular clusters are visible posterior to the gill region. A primary horizontal row of larger blobs runs along the mid-lateral line, with approximately 6-8 prominent nodes between the gill slits and the first dorsal fin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs, creating a grid-like pattern where the blobs serve as primary anchor points at the intersection nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible running along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp intensity gradient transition from high-luminance pixels on the dorsal edge to deep shadow on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin exhibits a distribution of approximately 12-15 discrete high-luminance blobs. The density is higher towards the base of the fin, with spots becoming smaller and more sparse towards the apex and trailing edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a dense, fine-grained pattern of small high-luminance spots along its leading edge, which transition into larger, more widely spaced blobs toward the trailing edge.
